methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The main focus of the work in this paper is the automatic detection of duty cycles in adsorption chillers by using the X-Means algorithm

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Data-mining/clustering (X-Means) method for duty-cycle and system-state detection (fault detection & diagnosis) in HVAC adsorption chillers. 'Energy performance indicators' are mentioned only incidentally as motivation; no EnPI/EnB measurement or baseline model is identified or characterised.

paper_type.evidence_quote: we use the data collected from the meters associated to the chiller

stage1.notes: Borderline eligibility: buildings/HVAC data-mining (X-Means) FDD demonstration on one adsorption chiller; EnPI mention incidental. paper_type arguably methodological/theoretical (method demo) but uses a real empirical dataset, so coded single applied case. level_3b=false (buildings, not a closed-list continuous-process sector).
